claude_proposed_widenings.name: paralyzed (Condition)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Hold Monster applies the Paralyzed condition on a failed WIS save. The Condition type currently only contains "prone". Encoding the onFail effect as apply_condition requires "paralyzed" to be a valid Condition variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Paralyzed condition for the duration.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: repeat_save_escape (end-of-turn repeat save to remove condition)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The v4 atom inventory includes repeat_save as a resolution atom, but there is no surface type variant in ActivationPhase or any lifecycle/ongoing attachment that expresses "at the end of each of the target's turns, it repeats the save; on success the spell ends". This is the canonical Hold Monster / Hold Person escape-hatch pattern. It requires a new surface shape linking an applied condition to a repeat_save resolution that fires on a per-turn trigger and removes the condition (and ends the spell) on success.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.
